findings.title: sanitize-html crashes on non-string input before @IsString() runs
findings.evidence: sanitize-html@2.18.2 throws `TypeError: this.buffers[0].slice is not a function` when called with a boolean or plain-object value (confirmed by running the installed package). NestJS ValidationPipe with transform:true executes @Transform (class-transformer plainToInstance) before @IsString() fires, so the type guard is gone and the crash reaches the error filter as an unhandled 500 for any request where a sanitized field carries a non-string JSON value (e.g. {"body": false}).
findings.consequence: Any client sending a boolean or object for a sanitized field receives a 500 instead of a 400. All 7 endpoints are reachable without authentication guards on the DTO itself, making this a denial-of-service path for authenticated users.
findings.correction: Restore the typeof guard: `@Transform(({ value }) => typeof value === 'string' ? sanitizeHtml(value, { allowedTags: [], allowedAttributes: {} }) : value)`
